GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, worked forward from the outside (#6) stall & took the lead entering the first turn, led rail by 2.5 Lengths exiting that turn, bowled along in front & led Two Wide by 1.25 Lengths turning, drifted wider rounding turn, under challenge from the 200m, got away again final 60m # always in control

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 1.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted 3 Wide Straightening Up and ran up to hit narrow Lead at 200m, almost immediately Headed then kept battling hard to the line # battled on well

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to within a half length turning, joined Lead 400m, took a narrow Lead Straightening Up , kept going in Straight getting away over the final 100m # bolted in

Jumped Ok Restrained Settled Down 3 Wide 5th 4 Lengths had no favours Out On A Limb Four Wide x 600m 3 Lengths , Under Pressure Straightening Up Joined in x 200m kept on tough to line Sound Effort ! - # 3-4 wide, gave all

Jumped awkwardly and Settled Down 5 Lengths on fence, made no ground to Turn then Made Ground 3-2 Wide in straight. [Stewards: COT - To be ridden more forward. Began awkwardly and settled midfield.] # ran on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Eased when awkwardly placed on heels when that runner shifted in when racing ungenerously. Shifted in across heels passing the 100m to obtain clear room.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 5 Lengths 3 Wide , Made Some Ground to 4 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Made Some Ground in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly while being restrained early stages.] # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly whilst being restrained early. Approaching the 100m steadied and altered course to avoid heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 9 Lengths Two Wide turning, Hooked Out Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in straight. (Blinkers OFF AGAIN, Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) AGAIN, Nasal Strip OFF FIRST TIME) # never a threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Laid out under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly then crowded (-1 length) and Settled Down 6.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up to 2.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and then crowded for room. Near the 1600m was bumped. Raced wide in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to 2 Lengths Lead on fence, Headed 1200m then Held Together in trail behind Leader during middle stages, moved up Two Wide from the 750m and retook Lead at 650m, led Two Wide by 1.5 Lengths turning, kept going in Straight but Headed at 200m and quickly beaten off by eventual winner. (Blinkers AGAIN, Winkers OFF AGAIN) # battled on ok
Jumped Fast comf Went Forward Took sit 2nd 1 Lengths Beaten off x 400m, (w/ag) # had its chance

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn 3 Lengths Two Wide , Checked badly at 200m and dropped back sharply. (Blinkers OFF FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie FIRST TIME) # bad check at 200m

Jumped well Straight to the front led 2 Lengths (1200m), ran them along To The Turn , Straightened Up shown the stick, kicking 200, headed 120, stayed on for second (overraced majority of race) # led/gave a sight
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported mount over-raced for the majority. Tnr advised may consider the addition of a tongue tie at the gelding’s next start.
